description: List the values the filters of search_items and list_items accept: the kinds with their types, the where-it-runs names and the topics in use, each with its number of items, plus how many items are open, how many are paid listings and how many have a recorded check. Use it before filtering by runs_on or topic, which must be given exactly as listed, and when you want an overview of what the shelf holds. Pass kind to count inside one kind only.

kind.description: Count only the items of this kind, for example build. Leave it out for the whole shelf.

name: list_filters

check_recorded.description: How many of the counted items have a check on record.

kind.description: The kind that was asked for, or null.

kinds.description: Every kind on the shelf with its number of items and its types.

runs_on.description: The where-it-runs names in use, most used first. Pass a value as runs_on.

topics.description: The topics in use, most used first. Pass a value as topic.

total.description: Items counted: the whole shelf, or the one kind asked for.

title: List filter values
